_schema: top-level vulnerability family index; members are agent-ready CWEs

memory-safety.description: Spatial/temporal memory errors: out-of-bounds read/write, overflow, use-after-free, double-free, NULL/uninitialized pointer, memory leak.

numeric-errors.description: Integer overflow/underflow, off-by-one, sign/truncation conversion errors; often the root cause feeding memory corruption.

race-condition.description: Improper synchronization of shared resources under concurrency/signals: races, TOCTOU, deadlock.

availability-and-error-handling.description: Improper handling of exceptional conditions and uncontrolled resource consumption: assertions, infinite loops, unreleased/unbounded resources.

input-validation-and-state-integrity.description: Missing/insufficient input validation and improper initialization of variables/resources leading to unsafe state.

data-exposure-and-trust.description: Exposure of sensitive information, missing encryption, and trust-boundary/HTTP smuggling issues.

access-control.description: Missing/incorrect authorization, improper authentication, and privilege/permission mismanagement.

injection.description: External input reaching an interpreter without neutralization: OS command, SQL, LDAP, XSS, format string, code injection, path traversal.

cryptography.description: Weak or broken cryptographic algorithms, insufficient strength/entropy, and improper signature verification.
